reports.title: Yesway, Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Full Year 2026 Outlook
section: The Company has reaffirmed its outlook for the following metrics as detailed below:

Adjusted EBITDA | $235 million - $245 million
Same-store Inside Merchandise Sales Growth | 1.25% - 3.25%
Capital Expenditures | $85 million - $95 million
New Store Openings | 6 – 8 new stores

desk.headline: Revenue up 35% to $969m, above estimates, on fuel; adjusted EBITDA up 9%; 2026 outlook reaffirmed

other.label: Stores
other.change: after selling 29 Iowa/Kansas stores and opening 4

results: Revenue jumped 35% to $969.2m, mostly because fuel sales rose 52% to $713.5m.
Fuel profit rose 20% to $76.0m as the margin widened to 46.1 cents a gallon and same-store gallons grew 1.1%.
In-store sales rose 4.0% to $246.4m (1.9% on a same-store basis) with a steady 35.1% margin.
Net income rose to $24.8m from $15.9m and adjusted EBITDA rose 8.6% to $59.6m; higher card fees lifted operating costs.
Yesway sold 29 stores in Iowa and Kansas in September and opened four, including its first in Arizona; cash was $104.6m against total debt of $607.9m.

guidance.summary: Yesway kept its 2026 outlook unchanged: adjusted EBITDA of $235-245m, same-store in-store sales growth of 1.25-3.25%, capex of $85-95m and 6-8 new stores.

watch: Whether the unusually high fuel margin holds up in Q4.
Same-store in-store sales against the 1.25-3.25% target in a tough consumer market.
Pace of new store openings and capex, which rose to $36.7m in the quarter from $11.3m.
